name: The Pale Handshake: Corps Share BCI Data
description: Street-level belief holds that at least four major corponations — including Cadrex Systems and the Mireille-Okonkwo Health Consortium — share anonymized BCI telemetry through a joint data broker called the Pale Handshake, despite presenting themselves as fierce competitors. The theory claims the arrangement began around 2208 after the Meridian Oversight Act threatened to regulate BCI data collection, and that pooling data allowed corps to claim compliance while actually expanding surveillance. Leaked internal documents circulated on the Underworld in 2219 under the handle 'Sablecrow' appeared to confirm a data-sharing arrangement, though Cadrex dismissed them as fabrications.
cultural_impact: Many Tier 2-3 residents now use BCI-scrubbing apps called 'bleach tabs' that claim to randomize telemetry signals, spawning a small grey-market industry and making corporate HR departments increasingly suspicious of employees who use them.
locations: Cadrex Systems Tower, Tier 4 North Corridor
The Meridian Oversight Authority building, Civic Spine
Underworld node cluster known as the Switchboard
story_hooks: A player character receives BCI-targeted advertising for something they only thought about — never searched, never said aloud
Sablecrow contacts the party claiming the next leak will get them killed and needing extraction
An Oversight auditor hires the party to verify whether the leaked documents are real — and then goes silent
believers: Tier 2-3 workers with BCIs, privacy advocates, anti-corporate activists, Underworld information brokers
evidence: The Sablecrow documents show a data-sharing framework but not its current operational status; BCI-targeted advertising anomalies are well-documented but officially explained as algorithmic coincidence
